text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Would you please give this "bottle" 
to Lady <chrname>?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This training session should be coming 
to a close quite soon, should it not? 
I learned as much during my earlier 
observations.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...I am rather a quick study, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I handed the refreshing drink 
provided by her 
over to <chrname>.
